newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says to abandon Skua oil field.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says to abandon Skua oil field.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to abandon the Skua oil field in the Timor Sea in February 1997.
The field first start production in December 1991.

The Skua field has produced nearly 20 million barrels of oil and will reach the end of its economic life early next year, BHP said. Output from Skua through the floating production vessel, Skua Venture, is currently about 4000 barrels of oil a day.
Skua is one of three BHP-operated fields in the Timor Sea, BHP said. BHP's Timor Sea production assets have produced a total of more than 155 million barrels to date, it said.

BHP said the joint venture partners in Skua had decided to sell the Skua Venture, a converted oil tanker. Talks are underway with potential buyers. It said layoffs would be minimised through a review of all offshore positions.
BHP holds 43.0295 percent of the Skua joint venture.

Santos Ltd units Peko Oil Ltd and Santos (NT) Pty Ltd hold 18.6137 percent and 11.9750 percent respectively, Mobil Corp unit Ampolex Ltd 9.2121 percent, Command Petroleum Ltd 9.0447 percent, Norcen Energy Resources Ltd 5.00 percent and Minora Energy Ltd, a unit of Discovery Petroleum NL 3.125 percent.
